content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
I'm a marketing professional with experience in email marketing, SEO, CRM systems, analytics, and business strategy. I use ChatGPT regularly and want to take my AI skills to the next level.

I'm looking for an experienced AI automation specialist who can teach me, one-on-one, how to build practical AI-powered workflows.

What I want to learn:

Make.com or n8n automation

Connecting AI with spreadsheets, CRMs, and marketing tools

Building practical AI agents

Automating marketing reporting and repetitive business tasks

Understanding APIs and integrations without extensive coding

Identifying AI opportunities that deliver measurable business value

I'm not looking for a generic AI course or someone to build everything for me.

I want hands-on lessons where I build real projects under your guidance.

Ideal candidate:

Has built AI automations for actual businesses

Has experience with marketing and CRM automation

Can explain technical concepts clearly to a nonprogrammer

Is patient, organized, and genuinely enjoys teaching

I'd like to begin with one paid trial lesson and potentially continue with weekly sessions.

Please include examples of systems you've built, your teaching experience, your hourly rate, and how you would structure our first four lessons.
</untrusted_participant_content>
